correctness.rationale: For every X_n>=6 epsilon, strict monotonicity gives exactly one next root. The exact recurrence yields the integral identity in the proof. The global step bound Delta_n<=C sqrt(epsilon) controls the symmetric Taylor expansion; its local defect is O(Delta_n^3), whose sum is O(epsilon). The terminal integral is O(epsilon). Thus D=K_epsilon*epsilon+O(epsilon), proving K_epsilon=D/epsilon+O(1).
